review_candidates.description: Build the next generation of autonomous construction robotics At MESH, we develop autonomous robotic systems that automate end-to-end rebar construction. Motion Planning: collision checking, trajectory generation and optimization, kinematics, robot/world modeling, and integration of planning algorithms. Robot Control: integration with industrial robot controllers, HAL layers, trajectory execution, real-time or near-real-time control interfaces, state monitoring, and coordination of multi-robotic systems. System Integration: connecting robotics SW, application logic, hardware, and external systems into reliable end-to-end robotic applications. Robotics Infrastructure: reusable software components, interfaces, configuration, logging, diagnostics, testing, simulation, and deployment infrastructure. Your Responsibilities Design, implement, test, and maintain robotics software primarily in C++ and Python. Develop and integrate components across the full robotics SW stack. Take algorithms and prototypes and mature them into reliable software components. Build automated tests, simulation-based tests, hardware-in-the-loop tests, and system-level validation where appropriate. Work with industrial robots, sensors, cameras, external axes, and other automation hardware. Develop clean interfaces between robotics algorithms, hardware drivers, application software, and higher-level systems. Diagnose complex problems that span software, algorithms, networking, robot controllers, sensors, and hardware. Improve observability through structured logging, diagnostics, error reporting, and system health monitoring. Support deployment, commissioning, troubleshooting, and validation of robotic systems. Requirements What We Are Looking For Required Masters degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field. Strong software engineering skills in C++, with working knowledge of Python. Experience developing software for robotic or other complex hardware systems. Good understanding of several areas of robotics, such as, motion and trajectory planning, robot control, vision, sensor and robot calibration. Experience with robotics middleware such as ROS/ROS2 or similar Comfortable working with Linux and modern software development workflows using Git, code reviews, build systems, debugging tools, and automated testing. Ability to debug problems across multiple layers of a robotic system rather than treating individual components in isolation. Strong understanding of software architecture, modularity, interfaces, and maintainability. Experience in one or more of the following would be an advantage: 3D perception using point clouds, depth cameras, stereo systems. Libraries such as Eigen, PCL, OpenCV, or similar. Collision detection, robot/world modeling, trajectory optimization, or numerical optimization. Real-time or high-performance robot communication and control. Profiling, performance optimization, concurrency, and multithreaded C++. Deploying and supporting robotic systems outside a controlled R&D environment. CI/CD and automated testing for robotics software. Experience working with industrial robotic arms such as ABB We do not expect you to be an expert in every part of the robotics stack. We are looking for strong software engineering fundamentals, depth in one or more robotics areas, and the ability and interest to work across subsystem boundaries. Eligibility Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Switzerland or be eligible to obtain the required Swiss work authorization without employer-sponsored visa support. Why Join MESH? Our goal is not only to develop new robotics capabilities, but to turn them into systems that solve challenging problems in real world deployments. You will have opportunities to work across the full robotics SW stack including system integration, and the software architecture connecting them rather than being restricted to a narrow subsystem. You will work directly on the engineering challenges that take robotics from promising prototypes to robust, repeatable, and deployable solutions. Solve challenging real-world robotics problems. Work with industrial robots, 3D vision systems, complex environments, and applications where conventional automation approaches reach their limits. See your work operate on real hardware. Develop software that moves beyond simulation and demos and becomes part of robotic systems deployed in real production environments. Have impact across the system. As part of a small, multidisciplinary engineering team, you will work closely across robotics, software, and hardware, with the opportunity to influence both technical decisions and how our robotics platform evolves.

review_candidates.title: Applied AI Engineer - Remote
review_candidates.description: 👋 Welcome to dexter health! At dexter health, we build AI-powered software for care teams. Our mission is to reduce administrative workload in healthcare so caregivers can spend more time with patients. We are looking for a high-agency AI Engineer to help us build new AI features faster and improve the quality, reliability, and speed of existing AI workflows. This is a hands-on engineering role. Not research. Not prompt-only. You will turn ambiguous product ideas into working, production-ready AI features. The role is mostly focused on shipping AI product features, with some AI systems and infrastructure work where needed. You will work closely with product and engineering, but we expect you to take real ownership. You should be comfortable moving fast, making technical decisions under ambiguity, and using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar every day. Tasks As our Applied AI Engineer, you will: Build new AI-powered product features from idea to production Improve existing AI workflows for quality, reliability, latency, and user value Design and implement LLM-based workflows, structured outputs, validation logic, and fallback behavior Build evaluation loops, tests, and quality checks for AI-generated outputs Integrate AI capabilities into existing product and backend systems Work with commercial and open-source LLMs without being tied to one specific provider Support self-hosted model workflows where they make sense for quality, speed, cost, or control Debug AI feature failures across inputs, outputs, data, backend logic, and user flows Use AI development tools as a core part of your daily workflow Ship quickly while keeping production quality hi Requirements We care less about formal seniority and more about speed, intelligence, ownership, and product impact. We like people who operate with founder-like urgency: they figure things out, make progress under ambiguity, and care about outcomes more than titles. Must-have Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language Experience building AI-powered product features or LLM-based workflows Ability to turn ambiguous product ideas into working software quickly Strong understanding of how to design, test, validate, and improve AI outputs Experience integrating AI workflows into production systems Strong debugging instincts across application logic, data, model outputs, and user-facing behavior Experience with evaluation, testing, validation, or quality checks for AI-generated outputs Serious experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar as part of your daily workflow High intelligence, fast learning speed, bias to action, and ownership mindset Comfortable with ambiguity, fast decisions, and a high-trust startup environment Clear written and spoken English Nice-to-have Experience with frontend or fullstack product development Experience with self-hosted LLMs, model serving, inference optimization, or similar systems Experience with open-source LLMs and related deployment workflows Experience improving latency, cost, quality, or reliability of AI systems Experience with healthcare software, healthcare data, or regulated environments Experience working with structured data extraction, documentation automation, voice workflows, or workflow automation German language skills Knowledge of nursing homes or elderly care workflows This role is probably not for you if You are mainly looking for an ML research role You are a prompt engineer without strong coding skills You need detailed specifications before making progress You prefer slow, highly structured corporate environments You are mainly looking for management, not hands-on building You want to use AI tools only occasionally instead of as part of your daily workflow You optimize for perfect process over fast, reliable execution Benefits Remote work Fair compensation based on skills, experience, and location Ownership of important backend systems Work on software used in real healthcare workflows Modern AI-native development workflow Room to grow with the company Why? Caregivers spend too much time on documentation, coordination, and administrative work. We build technology that reduces this burden. AI is core to our product. But useful AI features do not come from demos alone. They need strong engineering, fast iteration, evaluation, production thinking, and deep ownership of the user outcome. If you want to build AI product features that ship, improve real workflows, use AI tools every day, and take ownership in a fast-moving team, we would like to hear from you.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer C2 & Mission Planning
review_candidates.description: 📍 Location: Paris Region (on-site) 🛰️ Sector: Next-generation European Defense / Counter-UAS 💼 Type: Full-time, Permanent 📈 Seniority: Mid/Senior 💰 Compensation: Competitive Salary + Equity + Full Health Coverage About EGIDE EGIDE is building a new European defense leader focused on scalable, intelligent air-defense architectures. We develop mass-use interceptors and mission systems that combine missile- grade performance with modern embedded computing and advanced autonomy. We are growing fast and assembling a world-class technical team driven by ambition, engineering rigor, and real operational impact. If you want to help shape the future of European defense innovation, this is the place. About The Role We are seeking a Software Engineer (C++/Python) to design and build the C ommand & Control (C2) and Mission Planning software at the heart of our interceptor systems the layer that turns sensor data and operator intent into optimized, executable engagement plans. This is a deeply algorithmic role. You will translate hard applied-mathematics problems trajectory optimization, multi-target allocation, path planning, sensor fusion, and real-time decision-making into high-performance, reliable production code. You will own components across the full lifecycle, from mathematical formulation and architecture to implementation, testing, benchmarking, and deployment, working side by side with system engineers and guidance/estimation specialists. What You'll Do C2 & Mission-Planning Software Design and implement robust, scalable architectures for command-and-control and mission- planning systems Build the planning core: engagement scheduling, target interceptor allocation, and real-time replanning under uncertainty Develop high-performance components in C++, with clean Python bindings for usability and extensibility Ensure clean, well-defined interfaces between low-level compute and high-level operator- facing logic Applied Mathematics & Algorithms Formulate and solve optimization problems (constrained, combinatorial, and real-time) for planning and resource allocation Implement trajectory and path-planning algorithms, state estimation, and sensor/data fusion Translate mathematical and physical models into efficient, numerically stable code Analyze algorithmic complexity and guarantee performance under strict real-time constraints Performance & Reliability Write unit and integration tests to guarantee correctness of safety-critical logic Design and run benchmarks to validate latency, throughput, and numerical stability Maintain high code quality through best practices and code reviews You Are a Fit If You Have Strong software engineering skills in C++ and Python, with a solid grasp of software architecture and design patterns A strong applied-mathematics foundation: optimization, linear algebra, probability/statistics, numerical methods Experience turning mathematical models or algorithms into efficient, production-grade code Experience building Python bindings and clean, maintainable interfaces Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows Experience with automated testing frameworks The ability to promote and enforce good engineering practices across a team (code quality, testing, tooling, workflows) Nice to Have Knowledge of operations research, optimal control, estimation (e.g. Kalman filtering), or graph algorithms Experience with mission planning, robotics, autonomy, guidance/navigation, or multi-agent systems Familiarity with real-time or safety-critical systems Experience with scientific computing, benchmarking, and profiling tools A proactive mindset for improving team-wide engineering practices, tools, and workflows Experience in early-stage or R&D-driven projects Familiarity with human-machine interfaces (HMI) for operator-facing systems Experience with QGroundControl (or similar ground control station software) Why Join EGIDE? Build the future of European defense capability Work on real systems that fly fast Solve genuinely hard algorithmic and mathematical problems with direct operational impact Competitive salary + meaningful equity 100% health coverage A high-autonomy engineering culture A chance to shape a category-defining company from the ground up Ready to Join? If you want to work on cutting-edge defense systems, challenge yourself technically, and contribute to strategic European autonomy, we'd love to talk. Our recruitment process: First phone screen Deep dive Case study On-site final meeting

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Are you an experienced Automation Software Engineer, Controls Engineer or PLC Programmer with strong hands-on experience across PLCs, robotics, HMIs and vision systems ? Do you enjoy solving complex automation problems, improving machine performance and sharing your technical knowledge with other engineers? We're supporting a leading precision manufacturing business in Portsmouth who are looking to recruit a Senior Production Support Software Engineer to join their growing engineering team. This is a senior, hands-on position where you'll work directly with specialist automated manufacturing equipment, taking ownership of complex software and controls issues while helping develop the technical capability of the wider team. What's the role all about? As the Senior Production Support Software Engineer , you'll be responsible for maintaining, improving and developing the software and control systems behind specialist automated manufacturing machinery. You'll work across PLC, robotic, HMI and vision systems , identifying faults, improving existing software and implementing solutions that increase machine reliability and production throughput. This isn't purely a desk-based programming position. You'll work directly with production machinery, troubleshoot complex automation issues and collaborate closely with other engineers to ensure equipment performs effectively. As a senior member of the team, you'll also play an important role in mentoring and developing junior and mid-level engineers , sharing your knowledge and helping strengthen automation capability across the department. Key responsibilities Programme, modify and troubleshoot PLC-controlled automated machinery Develop and maintain Mitsubishi iQ-R PLC software Programme and troubleshoot Mitsubishi robotic systems Develop and support HMI systems Programme and optimise Keyence and Asyril vision systems Work with associated automation equipment including servo systems, RFID and inverters Diagnose and resolve complex software and automation faults Improve existing machine software to increase reliability, availability and throughput Identify opportunities to improve automated manufacturing processes Take ownership of complex technical problems from initial diagnosis through to resolution Work closely with Production and Engineering teams to minimise machine downtime Provide technical guidance across PLC, robotics, vision and automation systems Train, coach and mentor junior and mid-level engineers Share technical knowledge and engineering best practice across the team What you'll need This is a senior position, so we're looking for someone who already has a strong level of automation and controls expertise. You'll need: Proven experience within Automation, Controls or Production Support Engineering Strong practical experience programming PLCs Experience with Mitsubishi iQ-R or closely equivalent PLC systems Practical experience programming and fault finding industrial robots Mitsubishi robot experience or experience with comparable robotic platforms Experience programming HMI systems Hands-on experience with industrial vision systems Keyence, Asyril or equivalent vision system experience Strong understanding of software programming methodologies Excellent and methodical fault-finding skills Ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex automation problems Confidence modifying and improving existing machine software Experience training, mentoring or developing other engineers Technical environment You'll be working with technologies including: Mitsubishi iQ-R PLCs Mitsubishi Robots Keyence Vision Systems Asyril Vision & Flexible Feeding Systems HMIs Servo systems RFID Inverters Bespoke automated manufacturing machinery Direct experience with every specific manufacturer isn't essential, but you'll need strong hands-on experience with these technologies or closely equivalent industrial automation systems . About you You're an experienced automation professional who can confidently take ownership of technically challenging problems rather than relying on fixed solutions. You'll be: An excellent technical problem solver Methodical when fault finding Comfortable taking ownership and working independently Collaborative and willing to share your expertise A confident technical mentor Patient when developing less experienced engineers Highly detail-focused Interested in improving machine performance rather than simply maintaining the status quo Because the products manufactured are extremely small and precision-focused, attention to detail is essential . Why join? This is an excellent opportunity to join a business investing significantly in automation, technology and advanced manufacturing . You'll work in an engineering environment where automation is central to future growth, giving you the opportunity to influence machine performance, improve production capability and help develop the next generation of automation engineers. While ongoing training and development will be available, this is a genuine senior-level opportunity for someone who can bring significant automation expertise from day one. Salary & Benefits Competitive salary 25 days holiday plus bank holidays Additional 3 days off over the festive period Company pension scheme Company bonus scheme Life Cover 3x salary Employee Assistance Programme Ongoing technical training and development Interested? If you're an experienced Senior Automation Engineer, Controls Engineer, PLC Programmer, Automation Software Engineer or Production Support Engineer with strong PLC, robotics and vision system experience, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today or contact Kingdom People for a confidential discussion. Kingdom People are acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy. LNKD1_UKTJ
